result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 3, Articles 5-6) covering a tax's definitions and administration and sidewalk vending regulations, with no residential rental rules in this part.
result.notes: This part (76 of 364) contains only tax definitions (hotel/transient occupancy-related Additional Tax, street repair, homelessness programs), tax administration, and the Sidewalk Vending Regulations (Div. 1, Art. 6). The source URL points to the algorithmic rent-setting prohibition (section 98.1103), but that text does not appear in this part, so no rule in the six in-scope categories can be extracted from it. The passing mention of rental vouchers and security deposit subsidies in the homelessness-program definition is a funding description, not a rule on deposits or rent.
